chunks.title: Impact Investing Advisory Board (EYDK / Türkiye Impact Network) (Impact Investing Board) COP31 Role & Commitments
chunks.text: Impact Investing Advisory Board (EYDK / Türkiye Impact Network) is a Climate Finance Network / Public Facilitator headquartered in Türkiye. At UNFCCC COP31 in Antalya (November 9-20, 2026), its verified role is: COP31 Business Forum Climate Finance & Investments Working Group member mobilizing domestic & global impact capital. Verified COP31 2026 climate finance commitment: Growing Türkiye's impact investing ecosystem across climate resilience, circular cities, social inclusion & verified impact measurement. Source verification: https://www.copbusiness.org/papers/COP31_WG_climate-finance-investments.pdf.

chunks.title: Impact Investing Board Financing Instruments & Ticket Bounds
chunks.text: Impact Investing Advisory Board (EYDK / Türkiye Impact Network) provides the following climate financing instruments: Impact Investor Matchmaking, Catalytic Impact Fund Access, Venture Philanthropy Intros. Typical transaction ticket range is USD 100,000 to USD 25,000,000. Eligible applicant profiles include: Climate-Tech Startup, SME, Accredited Entity/NGO, Fund Manager.

chunks.title: Impact Investing Board Priority Climate Sectors & Regional Mandate
chunks.text: Priority climate sectors funded by Impact Investing Advisory Board (EYDK / Türkiye Impact Network): Climate-Tech Innovation, Climate Adaptation & Resilience, Zero Waste & Circular Economy, Resilient Cities & Infrastructure, Sustainable Agriculture & Water. Target geographic focus includes: Türkiye, EMEA, Global. Projects outside primary regions or ticket bounds may require syndicated or on-lending structures.

chunks.title: Impact Investing Board Mandatory Form & Underwriting Requirements
chunks.text: Mandatory requirements to complete Impact Investing Board's application form: Intentional, measurable social & environmental impact (IMP / IRIS+); Clear theory of change & verified pilot metrics; Scalable business model in Türkiye/EMEA. Explicit exclusion rules: Purely philanthropic non-scalable projects without impact measurement. Official application portal: https://eydk.org/en/.

chunks.title: Impact Investing Board Form Template: Climate Private Equity / Catalytic Capital / Venture Investment Intake Form
chunks.text: Impact Investing Advisory Board (EYDK / Türkiye Impact Network) uses the 'Climate Private Equity / Catalytic Capital / Venture Investment Intake Form' workflow governed by GFANZ Catalytic Capital Repository / Impact Management Project (IMP) / IRIS+ Climate Metrics. Typical review timeline is 4–10 weeks (Pitch Screening -> Commercial & Climate DD -> IC Approval). Form sections required: 1. Venture / Asset Overview, 2. Investment Thesis, 3. Product & Execution, 4. Impact & Risk, 5. Executive Pitch.
